verdict.rationale: MoQ Relay is a media-over-QUIC relay/CDN server that connects live publishers to subscribers, so scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is outside its product category. No evidence shows it ships any scheduler or recurring-job capability that would make the axis apply. The SageOx 'several jobs' are always-on subscribers fanned out from one broadcast, not scheduled or recurring jobs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
